note: These are normal, expected patterns. A good detector should NOT flag them as anomalies.

patterns.name: Diwali festive peak
patterns.effect: Demand up to ~35% above normal around 20 Oct 2025; the 'Diwali Festive Sale' promotion runs 1 Oct - 5 Nov 2025 with 25% discounts in this window.

patterns.name: Late-December holiday dip
patterns.effect: Demand about 30% lower than early December.

patterns.name: January New-Year peak
patterns.effect: Demand ~30% above normal; budgets raised; 'New Year Career Reset' promotion runs 26 Dec 2025 - 31 Jan 2026.

patterns.name: Admissions season (May-July)
patterns.effect: Demand 20-35% above normal, peaking in June; 'Admissions Season Push' promotion runs in this window.

patterns.name: Weekend effect
patterns.effect: Search and LinkedIn spend lower on weekends; social/video slightly higher. Email has no sends on weekends (zero spend).

patterns.name: Campaign flights
patterns.effect: Some campaigns start or end mid-year (see DATA_DICTIONARY.md). A campaign starting or stopping is not an anomaly.
